sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

The petitioners are before this Court seeking the following prayer:
"To quash First Information Report dated 26.05.2024 in Crime No.95 of 2024,
registered by the South Women Police Station, Bengaluru, as Annexure 'A'."
2.

Heard Sri.Lingaraj Mallanna, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Smt.Sowmya R.,
learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1 and have perused the material on record.
3. The parties were also before the Family Court in M.C. No.5526/2024, wherein the couple have settled the matter by a separation.
The settlement also recognizes co- operation for withdrawal of the cases pending against each other.
One of which is the present impugned proceedings.

The settlement insofar as narrates about the present proceedings, read as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC:40484 "MEMORANDUM OF SETTLEMENT UNDER SECTION 89 OF CPC READ WITH RULES 24 AND 25 OF THE KARNATAKA CIVIL PROCEDURE (MEDIATION) RULES, 2005.

The parties above named to submit as follows:
1. x x x 13.

The 2nd Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the 1st Petitioner and his family members for quashing the First Information Report registered pursuant to her complaint in Crime No.95 of 2024 by the South Zone Women Police Station,
Basavanagudi, Bangalore, pending on the file of the XXXVII Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bangalore before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka, Bangalore.

4. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offences being punishable under Section 498A of IPC and that of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the settlement and terminate the proceedings against the petitioners.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
NC: 2024:KHC:40484 ORDER i. The petition is disposed.
